trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations with significant tissue loss (large non-linear indentations) on the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe exhibits smaller, more frequent jagged peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of parallel and intersecting high-intensity white linear marks (rake marks) concentrated on the left lobe, cutting through both black and white pixel regions.
